messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use amoxicillin if you are allergic to any penicillin antibiotic.
Examples of penicillin antibiotics include ampicillin, dicloxacillin, oxacillin, penicillin, and ticarcillin.
To make sure Amoxicillin is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have:
Tell your doctor if you have phenylketonuria (PKU).
The chewable tablets may contain phenylalanine.
It is not known whether Amoxicillin will harm an unborn baby.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
Amoxicillin can make birth control pills less effective.
Ask your doctor about using a non-hormonal birth control (condom, diaphragm, cervical cap, or contraceptive sponge) to prevent pregnancy.
It may not be safe to breastfeed while using Amoxicillin.
Ask your doctor about any risk.

The relation 'requires patient consultation about' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the patient to consult with their doctor about the specific concern or risk specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
